newsitem.title: GERMANY: IG Medien says close to German printing wage deal.
newsitem.headline: IG Medien says close to German printing wage deal.

text.p: Germany's printing union, IG Medien, said on Thursday it was close to completing a wage deal with employers for the industry's 130,000 workers after a 23-hour negotiating session.

IG Medien negotiator Franz Kersjes said "we are in the vicinity of a deal" that would offer a wage increase as well as lay out concrete rules for sick-pay benefits which are allowed to be changed under a law passed by Bonn late last year.

Industry employers have said wages were likely to rise about 1.5 percent under the deal to take effect on April 1. Sick-pay benefits will be maintained at 100 percent but the annual Christmas bonus will be cut by five percent.
